# Since 8.1, using namespace with ObjectModel will throw a PrestaShopLogger issue

Since this change : https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/commit/39e5ad1392dc46b8e2bdd1d60d35cbee418b4395

While using a namespace into our own ObjectModel classes, the save of an element into a AdminController using this namespace will work but throw an alert about PrestaShopLogger->object_type as not valid.

## Étapes
1. Use ObjectModel with namespace
2. Use a ModuleAdminController using this ObjectModel as ClassName
3. Save the form
4. See the alert
